authority: toscanini/conversational/problem_understanding.py (the code is the authority; this document is its published contract)
purpose: The canonical structured interpretation of a user's problem, produced BEFORE the discovery pipeline begins. An INPUT RECORD, never a discovery claim: it precedes and can never promote any epistemic state (Art. XXVIII). The engine-facing problem dict (toscanini/problem_builder.py) remains the engine's own authority; this contract interprets the problem for the product and the conversational layer.
directive_reference: CODER 1 - DISCOVERY INTELLIGENCE / CLAUDE-LIKE PROBLEM PROCESSING, section 3

desired_outcome.description: What the user wants to maximize/minimize/achieve, from outcome-verb phrases

observed_failure.description: The failure noun phrase(s) found in the message (trimmed to the failure-noun core)

constraints.description: Engineering requirements any solution must satisfy; default engine constraint applied when the user stated none (typed INFERRED_MODEL)

context.description: Deterministic surface features of the message (length, interrogative form, domain words)

domain_hypothesis.description: Deterministic keyword-scored domain hypothesis (medical/fluid/thermal/energy/automotive/aerospace/electronics/industrial/materials); full ranking in domain_scores

physical_system.description: The system noun phrase matched in the message

target_variable.description: The quantity to optimize; the canonical clarification trigger when UNKNOWN

unknowns.description: Fields whose origin is UNKNOWN, with why and the resolution path — never filled with a guess (Art. XXV)

success_condition.description: Composed from the stated outcome and target variable; UNKNOWN when either is unknown

failure_condition.description: The engine's standing falsification contract (Art. XX/LII)

origin_vocabulary.USER_STATED: the user's own words carry the content (never overridden by LLM extraction; disagreements recorded, never silent)
origin_vocabulary.INFERRED_MODEL: derived by deterministic rules from the text (the two-stage constructor's first stage; zero LLM)
origin_vocabulary.MODEL_DERIVED_LLM: proposed by the LLM extractor (untrusted, Art. XVIII; fills UNKNOWN slots only)
origin_vocabulary.UNKNOWN: not established - a legitimate epistemic state; never a plausible guess

construction.llm_enrichment: enrich_with_extraction(pu, extraction) - merges problem_builder's MODEL_DERIVED fields; USER_STATED fields are never overridden; disagreements are recorded
construction.clarification_merge: apply_clarification_answer(pu, field, answer) - the ONLY conversation-derived path that may touch a PU field; the answer is USER_STATED and the PU is an input record, not canonical scientific state

persistence.run_dir: PROBLEM_UNDERSTANDING.json (written by the worker phase 2.1, before the engine starts)

invariants: Every field carries {value, origin, basis, confidence}
An inferred field NEVER silently becomes fact (Art. XXVIII)
UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN until a user answer or LLM extraction fills it
The PU can never mutate canonical scientific state (conversation_memory guard)
